verdict.rationale: Rive documents a built-in AI agent that generates scripts, responsive layouts, data models and animation, plus MCP tools for View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes. None of the evidence shows image generation, background removal, content-aware fill or copy suggestions inside the editor. That agent is an adjacent AI feature aimed at structural and authoring tasks, not the asset chores this story names, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor
